name: Culture Amp
description: Culture Amp is an employee experience platform that combines engagement and pulse surveys with continuous performance management, structured review cycles, and AI-assisted people analytics, used by HR and people teams to measure sentiment and run performance programs across an organization.
best_for: HR and people teams that want a dedicated employee engagement and performance platform combining survey-based sentiment tracking with continuous feedback and structured review cycles, rather than a performance module bundled into a broader HRIS.
features: Engage: employee engagement, pulse, DEI, and retention surveys built on 40+ ready-to-use templates
AI-generated comment summaries and benchmarking of survey results against other Culture Amp customers
Perform: continuous feedback, structured performance reviews, and calibration tools
360-degree feedback, 1-on-1 conversation tools, and employee shoutouts/recognition
Develop: goal management, goal alignment, and personal development planning
Skills coaching and employee development plans
AI Coach, an in-product assistant that turns engagement data into action plans and assists with writing performance reviews
Integrations with common HRIS and workplace SaaS platforms
pros: Offers separate, purpose-built modules for engagement (Engage), performance (Perform), and development (Develop) rather than one generic module
Provides 40+ pre-built survey templates plus benchmarking data drawn from other Culture Amp customers
cons: Pricing is not published; every plan requires requesting a quote based on employee count, product mix, and service tier
No free trial or free tier is advertised on the public pricing page

alternatives.name: Lattice
alternatives.description: A people management platform combining continuous performance reviews, goal tracking, and engagement surveys with core HRIS record-keeping.
alternatives.best_for: Companies that want performance management and engagement surveys paired with HRIS record-keeping in one platform.

alternatives.name: BambooHR
alternatives.description: A small and mid-sized business HRIS that includes performance management and employee satisfaction surveys alongside core HR record-keeping.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that want engagement and performance features bundled into a broader HR system of record rather than a dedicated survey and performance platform.
